vectors.name: timestamp_generate_ms_min_rng_min
vectors.description: boundary: ms = 0, all-0x00 rng — the minimum 16-byte payload

vectors.name: timestamp_generate_ms_min_rng_max
vectors.description: boundary: ms = 0, all-0xff rng

vectors.name: timestamp_generate_ms_max_rng_max
vectors.description: boundary: ms = 2^48 - 1 (281474976710655), all-0xff rng — the maximum 16-byte payload

vectors.name: reverse_extract_running_example
vectors.description: the 6 timestamp bytes are bitwise-inverted before encoding; extract re-inverts them

vectors.name: reverse_generate_ms_min_rng_min
vectors.description: boundary: ms = 0, all-0x00 rng — inverted ts bytes (0xff) sort the epoch last

vectors.name: reverse_extract_ms_min_rng_min
vectors.description: re-inverts the 0xff ts bytes back to ms = 0

vectors.name: reverse_generate_ms_min_rng_max
vectors.description: boundary: ms = 0, all-0xff rng

vectors.name: reverse_generate_ms_max_rng_min
vectors.description: boundary: ms = 2^48 - 1 (281474976710655), all-0x00 rng — inverted ts bytes (0x00) sort newest first

vectors.name: reverse_extract_ms_max_rng_min
vectors.description: re-inverts the 0x00 ts bytes back to ms = 2^48 - 1

vectors.name: reverse_generate_ms_max_rng_max
vectors.description: boundary: ms = 2^48 - 1 (281474976710655), all-0xff rng

vectors.name: to_uuid_running_example
vectors.description: the 16 payload bytes written verbatim as an RFC 9562 lowercase hyphenated UUID

vectors.name: from_uuid_uppercase_accept
vectors.description: RFC 9562 parsers accept uppercase hex; output is the same canonical id

vectors.name: from_uuid_reject_braces
vectors.description: braced {…} form is rejected; only the hyphenated 8-4-4-4-12 form is accepted

vectors.name: canonicalize_uppercase
vectors.description: ASCII A-Z folds to lowercase

vectors.name: canonicalize_alias_o_to_zero
vectors.description: Crockford visual alias o/O resolves to 0 before validation

vectors.name: canonicalize_reject_padding_bit
vectors.description: final base32 char '1' has non-zero low 2 bits (not in [048cgmrw])

vectors.name: canonicalize_reject_wrong_prefix
vectors.description: a well-formed id of a different brand is rejected at the prefix layer (vectors are authored against brand usr)

vectors.name: from_uuid_reject_not_string
vectors.description: non-string input (null) is rejected at the not_a_string layer before any UUID shape check

vectors.name: canonicalize_reject_not_string
vectors.description: non-string input (a number) is rejected at the not_a_string layer before any prefix/base32 check

vectors.name: canonicalize_reject_unicode_kelvin
vectors.description: U+212A KELVIN SIGN is not ASCII; SPEC case folding is ASCII-only, so it is not folded to 'k' and the payload is rejected at the base32 layer (guards against String.prototype.toLowerCase() Unicode aliasing)

vectors.name: canonicalize_reject_overlong_wrong_prefix
vectors.description: overlong input (31 chars) whose leading slice is not the codec prefix is rejected at the prefix layer, not base32 — first-failing-layer rule applies even when the input also trips the length guard

vectors.name: canonicalize_reject_overlong_right_prefix
vectors.description: overlong input (31 chars) whose leading slice IS the codec prefix still reports base32 — the prefix passed, so the oversized payload is the first failure
